name: 家居派对一次性印花盛装纸盘款
description: 派对聚餐一次性印花纸盘套图，从白底整摞主图到上桌盛装与规格选款收口

styleLock.direction: bright everyday tableware commerce with clean infographic screens
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots, pale sage #EEF2E0 for benefit and line-up screens, warm linen #F3E7DC for pain-point panels, real table textiles for lifestyle frames, single navy #1E3C72 band for the close
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright neutral soft studio light, front-left key with fill card, soft contact shadows that always ground the product; lifestyle frames switch to 5500K window or late-afternoon sun with the same left-side direction
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte pale tablecloths and linen runners #D7E6E4 and #DFE3E1, neutral putty board #E9E3DA for macro, checked cloth for dining overheads
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, headline and label copy added in post only, generated frames keep empty label bars with no legible characters
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line pictograms in one accent, small shield-free utility glyphs, flat circular seal frames left empty
styleLock.presentationRules: printed rim border always intact and repeated consistently across screens, plates shown face-up from above or in clean side profile as a wrapped stack, stable scale between the pack and single pieces
noDrift: no redesign of the printed rim pattern
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bright premium everyday-tableware visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, pale sage #EEF2E0, navy #1E3C72 text and header bands, and one coral #E8734A accent; neutral soft studio lighting with a front-left key, fill card and soft contact shadows that always ground the product; modern geometric sans-serif, all rendered copy left to post production; consistent thin single-weight line icon style and empty circular seal frames; clean high-end tableware product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale, stable printed rim pattern, single face-up or clean side-profile presentation; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表第一眼看清整摞家庭装的份量感与花色边带，赢下点击
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, shrink-wrapped stack in clean 90-degree side profile, full pack visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front-left softbox key with fill card, soft contact shadow under the pack
shots.whitespace: none, pack centered with even edge margins
shots.promptTemplate: Packshot of {product}: the shrink-wrapped stack of plates seen in a clean 90-degree side profile, straight-on and eye-level, the printed border reading as repeating colour bands around the wrap. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left softbox key and a fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadow grounding the pack. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The stack occupies 60-70% of the frame, centred with no extra whitespace and no copy overlaid. 8K commercial tableware e-commerce quality. Negative: no loose plates fanned out, no hands, no watermark, no wordmark or logo plate, no barcode, no qr code, no legible characters anywhere, no cut-off edges, no floating pack without contact shadow.

shots.intent: 一秒讲清花色边饰与空盘容量，把卖点主张位留给后期文案

shots.props: two blank rounded label chips at the outer edge
shots.whitespace: generous even margin ringed around the plate, no copy overlaid
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero: one single {product} lying face-up, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle so the printed border reads as an even ring around the empty centre. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Negative: no food, no cutlery, no hands, no legible characters inside the chips, no watermark, no fake logo, no gradient background, no duplicated or rotated rim pattern, no floating plate.

shots.intent: 微距证明卷边与压纹做工，用可见质感替代任何参数主张

shots.whitespace: minimal, the rim detail is the subject

Negative: no blurry subject, no frayed or torn rim, no visible layer separation, no hands, no food crumbs, no watermark, no text, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 单盘正面朝上、盘面叠加大字主张与多枚小图标；002 同款空盘正俯视，只见印花边饰；003 双栏对照信息图，栏首两个商品缩略、栏内三行属性配勾形符号与倍数数字；004 双手自桌沿端起盛满生菜番茄沙拉的盘，底部一条深色横幅图标加主张；005 高 45 度俯拍格纹桌布上的正餐摆桌，配木柄刀叉、酱汁小碗与冰水杯，底部同款深色横幅；006 戴手套双手捧堆肥悬于敞口桶上，草地虚化背景，底部横幅主张；007 四格规格矩阵，每格同款花色不同直径并各配一份食物，其中一格上方有标记箭头；008 盘背密集信息墙（条形码、方形导流码、多枚认证印章、工厂地址与说明段）；009 整摞塑封包装侧视，边带花色成环；010 浅绿底上的单枚认证图形加深色横幅。品类判定依据：主体为一次性纸制餐盘，功能是使用后即弃的餐桌盛装具，故取 L2 水具餐具，而非纸品清洁（擦拭用纸）或厨房用品（耐用手工具），亦未沿用源列表把此类目挂在餐厨耗材下的写法；源图为方形 1:1，全套按 1:1 出。已剥离内容：品牌字标与系列字样、母公司与厂商标识、倍数强度对比数字、片数与直径及厘米规格、防油与耐切割与可微波等功能主张、可降解与林业认证图形与编号、条形码与方形导流码、全部图内英文原句与底部横幅文案、列表页徽章与星级类社会证明（含源列表附带的原平台店铺字样）；008 的密集资质墙只保留为 007 与 009 中的空白标签条与空白印章框；人物只留手部与颈部以下，无可辨识面容；盛装食物一律按食品 negative 处理，不含任何事实数值与检测主张，卖点承载位全部留白。
